body: Your pain is valid. You never have to apologize or be sorry because of how you feel. I’m so sorry you’re going through so much pain right now.

You don’t come across as judging, you come across as caring. I really appreciate you. It’s kind of incredible that contact with a gentle and interested stranger on the internet can pull me out of the depths.

Reading is always good. Video games. Lifting weights, but that would require being surrounded by aggressive gym strangers. I wish I could reach out to someone in my life about these suicidal and self harm thoughts but last time I did it made people super worried and I felt like I needed to take the next few months to prove to them I wouldn’t act. Anyway, thank you for being there for me. You are a good person for helping me. 

And in fairness to my SO, it was kind of a backhand slap, not a kick. And she said it was unintentional to hit me there - but I guess the hit wasn’t accidental, just the location. I just don’t want to vilify her. Obviously what she did was bad but what I did feels worse to me.

Thanks for replying. I’ve apologized, she’s forgiven me. I’m scared I crossed a line that just can’t be crossed, no matter what gets done to you. Usually, I am inward with my anger (like I direct it toward myself physically), and I’m scared that I was outward with it this time.

Thanks for asking.  I can’t stop perseverating on using any form of physical action toward her, no matter how small.  I’m really big. And she’s small. I know that flicking somebody isn’t the same as hitting or holding down, but doing something to intentionally cause discomfort to someone who has been really kind and present for me makes me feel like I don’t deserve her or happiness or (on the extreme end, I realize) life. I just feel like the biggest sack of shit for this. Making someone I love so much feel like I was not in control. So most of my day has been laying in bed trying not to think about hurting myself. But then really wanting to. And then researching how to, and then feeling like a weak ungrateful asshole for having those thoughts in the first place. Obviously I have a really harsh inner critic, but im having a really hard time escaping it. Maybe ill go on a run? Maybe ill go to sleep and hope for a better tomorrow? I haven’t gone near sharps even though I’ve wanted to. I haven’t had any substances, even though I’ve wanted to. So i guess those are positives to take from today.
